title: Rethinking LLM Bias Probing Using Lessons from the Social Sciences

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and categorizing 24 existing gender bias probes (specifically gender-occupation bias) using the proposed EcoLevels framework, which classifies methods into association-level tasks (e.g., word embeddings, coreference resolution), task-dependent decisions (e.g., pronoun resolution), and naturalistic outputs (e.g., resume classification, dialogue generation).

Discussed contextually to draw parallels with social science methods (e.g., the Implicit Association Test for anti-Black attitudes) and evaluated via example sentence-pair prompts from datasets like CrowS-Pairs to demonstrate stereotype probability scoring.
